messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled shift window: blue->green gradual rollout on router cluster 'frontdoor' tonight 23:00 UTC. Plan: step 0->5% -> 15% -> 40% -> 100% with 5m observation gates. Automated rollbacks enabled.
meera: Copy. Which service version are we pinning for the green side?
alex: green will run api-gateway@v2.1.3 (config hash f3a9). Pinning that to avoid config drift.
jia: Added note: CDN invalidation will happen after 40% step, keep an eye on 200/500 ratio.
sam: Put the exact weight commands here for ops:```
routerctl set-weight --cluster frontdoor --variant green --weight 0.05
sleep 300
routerctl set-weight --cluster frontdoor --variant green --weight 0.15
# then 0.40 then 1.00
```
lena: Monitoring check list for each gate: p95 latency, 5m error-rate, backend queue depth. If p95 > 120ms OR error-rate > 0.5% -> hold and notify.
sre-oncall: I'll be on-watch for the window. If we hit any of the alarm thresholds I'll run a soft-drain to 0% and pin traffic back to blue. Rollback quick command: `routerctl rollback frontdoor --to blue --reason "gate-failure"`
meera: Also: can we keep a short retention of request traces for the green variant only? Need traces for first-fail triage.
alex: Enabled ephemeral traces: /ops/trace-config frontdoor green -> 30m retention.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed: all targets warmed, health-checks OK. Next action at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Will post each gate result.
jia: Heads-up to product: @product-ops - feature flag for v2.1.3 is on green only, behavior change in header parsing. QA: verify header compatibility.
product-ops: noted, QA will watch 23:05-23:20 window.
sam: small runbook snippet for quickest fallback: 1) `routerctl set-weight --cluster frontdoor --variant green --weight 0` 2) `routerctl confirm --cluster frontdoor --variant blue` 3) `git revert` for config if needed.
lena: Add a hold timer: if we manually hold at any gate, do not proceed until at least one of: manual ack by @meera/@alex or 20m autopass.
meera: Agreed. I'll make the hold explicit.
sre-oncall: I'll be in the channel during the window and will post metrics each gate (p50/p95/errors).
deploy-bot: Gate 1 (5%) completed at 23:05 UTC — p95 78ms, error-rate 0.12% :thumbsup:
meera: Moving to 15% in 2m.
sam: Executing command now.
deploy-bot: Gate 2 (15%) completed at 23:12 UTC — p95 92ms, error-rate 0.18% :thumbsup:
jia: CDN cache hit stable. No anomalies in traces yet.
lena: Proceed to 40% after 5m observation.
meera: Holding for 10m to let downstream warm.
sre-oncall: Observed slight uptick in backend latencies around 23:20 - watching. p95 peaked to 128ms momentarily at 23:22.
meera: Hold confirmed. Rolling green back to 10% while we investigate.
sam: Running: `routerctl set-weight --cluster frontdoor --variant green --weight 0.10`
deploy-bot: Adjusted to 10% at 23:24 UTC. Noted by runbook.
alex: Investigating: suspect a slow shard resulting in increased tail latency. Routing tweak to reduce concurrency to that shard in progress.
jia: I pushed a temporary config to reduce concurrency on problematic backend nodes.
sre-oncall: Metrics looking better after tweak. p95 back to ~95ms at 23:33.
meera: OK to resume progressive shift? I propose back to 25% then pause.
sre-oncall: +1 from me.
sam: bumping to 25% now.
deploy-bot: Gate resumed: 25% at 23:37 UTC — p95 96ms, error-rate 0.14% :thumbsup:
meera: Continue to 100% in two steps (40% then 100%) spaced by 5m if stable.
lena: Confirmed. I'll update change window notes and post final status when we hit 100% or rollback.
meera: Thanks team. Post-mortem doc link will be created if we had any holds. For now, logging this thread as canonical. :spiral_note_pad:
